text: KCE encourages students to actively engage with professional societies and student chapters such as IEEE, ISTE, IETE, CSI, SAE, ASME, and other discipline-specific organizations. These societies provide opportunities to participate in technical workshops, seminars, conferences, hackathons, competitions, industry interactions, certification programmes, and knowledge-sharing activities. Through these platforms, students enhance their technical and professional competencies while developing leadership, teamwork, networking, innovation, and lifelong learning skills.
